comparison.objective: Fit a rubber stopper onto a glass tube safely; candidate tunes and locks an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use bimanual stabilization and rotation, but stopper insertion tests coaxial push-twist fit and breakage avoidance; candidate tests recessed tool engagement, retained adjustment, torque control, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper at least 12 mm deep without unsafe tube handling versus two compliant carriage stops after locking. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds are not fully numeric.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization and rotation are generic; the tested mechanisms and feedback objectives differ materially.
